name: zclipalt_remap_point_xy_in_place
description: zClipAlt::RemapPointXYInPlace copies a point into the shared clip vertex buffer, rejects points outside the alternate clip rectangle, and remaps accepted x/y coordinates through the configured alternate clip scale and bias.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4766a0 validates copying input x/y to g_Clip_PolyVerts[0], passing gClipRect_Alt with a vertex count of 1 to zClipRect::TrivialRejectPolyXY, returning 0 without mutating the input point on rejection, and remapping x/y by g_zClipAlt_RemapScaleX/Y plus g_zClipAlt_RemapBiasX/Y on acceptance.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4766a0 has no function or address warnings, and its only direct callee is accepted in the functional-verification mode.
The native smoke covers both accepted and rejected one-point cases, including the shared clip vertex copy, in-place remap result, and rejection preserving the input point.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x4766a0 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
